objective: Run an exact-SHA, no-training, streaming S10 audit of conservative remaining-budget early resolution for every live frozen-H67-ep35 ATLIF/PSN site; quantify exact term skip, 32-lane within-context compaction cycles, quantization/range violations and the fixed-compute projection before any RTL admission.

paper_identity.main: frozen full-resolution H67 ep35 with no_running BN policy
paper_identity.paft_ep4_role: diagnostic only; M193 freezes current PAFT and rejects hardware-accuracy promotion

numeric_contract.operator: dense T-by-T PSN addmm followed by official binary ATLIF threshold
numeric_contract.input_scale: checkpoint/site static power-of-two scale frozen by the sealed sample0 full-call DP-TME vector generator
numeric_contract.range_violation: any unclamped code outside [-128,127]; saturation remains executable for diagnostics but fails promotion
numeric_contract.symmetric_metadata_violation: any unclamped code outside [-127,127], reported separately
numeric_contract.weight: sealed per-site power-of-two signed INT8 and exact code comparison against weight.mem
numeric_contract.bias_threshold: sealed signed Q24 code comparison against bias.mem and threshold.mem
numeric_contract.accumulator: signed Acc24 with every reordered prefix and final value checked
numeric_contract.remaining_bounds: per-output suffix min/max over the full legal signed-INT8 input interval [-128,127]
numeric_contract.issue_order: one shared per-site source-time permutation sorted by descending sum over output times of absolute quantized weight
numeric_contract.event_reference: quantized integer event; mismatch to the original floating model event is reported and is not hidden

cycle_contract.baseline: ten source issues per consecutive 32-spatial-lane tile for T10
cycle_contract.conservative_tile_stop: a tile stops only when every output time and spatial lane in the tile is resolved
cycle_contract.lane_compaction: within one module/call and issue step, spatial lanes requiring that step may be packed into 32-lane groups; output-time slots retain their identities
excluded: unbounded queues or zero-cost compaction fabric

claim_boundary: M366 is a frozen-H67-ep35/no-running S10 integer opportunity capture. PAFT ep4, rank3, accuracy, RTL, memory-system cycles, energy, PPA, system speedup and headline claims are excluded until separately admitted.
